status: PROPOSED 23 Nov 2026 - not in force until the owner approves; policy_v4 governs until then
score: as policy v4 (S over equal-weighted regions, paired against the adopted reference), with a paired region bootstrap (scripts/score_ci.py, 20,000 resamples)
development_regions: as v4 (55 regions: dev49 + tropical set t) plus each spent sealed set once spent (r now; s after use)
adopt_if: dev: the 90 % upper bound of S over the development regions is below 1.0 (a real gain, P(no gain) < 5 %), replacing the fixed S <= 0.995
dev: neither T nor P over the development regions worsens by more than 1 % (point values, as v4)
sealed: ONE run on a fresh sealed set of 18 regions (three 6-region draws, 0-60 deg): point S <= 1.0 AND its 90 % lower bound below 1.0 (not clearly worse)
continuations: a refit that fails may be continued at most once, declared before it runs; its finalist meets the same gates
why: the fixed 0.5 % line sits inside the region-sampling noise (sd 0.003-0.005), and 6 sealed regions cannot tell a 1 % gain from none (sd ~0.035); 18 regions cut that to ~0.02
cost: sealed runs triple (18 regions, minutes per run); no extra development runs
